payload.text: hv, 18 Oct, directly to dc, asked whether to start kovacs (stopped at 19:38Z) for vc's Linux leg before the push: "Leave it stopped." So the Linux leg of vc's 19:35Z item is not run today and nothing was started on kovacs or this Mac. Whether main is pushed without it is hv's and vc's; if it is, CI's Ubuntu leg is the first Linux run of today's commits (0069, 0070, 0071, the devbin 0.1.12 sweep).
